timestamp.comment: Valid line timestamps [mm:ss.xx] (minutes up to four digits); seconds are restricted to 0-59 so that [01:60] falls through to invalid-bracket.
timestamp.name: constant.numeric.timestamp.lrc

word-timing.comment: Valid enhanced-LRC (A2) word timings <mm:ss.xx> (minutes up to four digits).
word-timing.name: constant.numeric.word-timing.lrc

section-label.comment: Bracketed content that is NOT timing-shaped: section labels like [Chorus] and annotations like [foo:bar]. Rendered neutrally — the analyzer treats these as lyric text, never as errors.
section-label.name: entity.name.section.lrc

word-timing-invalid.comment: Timing-shaped <...> tokens that failed the valid word-timing rule, e.g. <00:60>.
word-timing-invalid.name: invalid.illegal.bracket.lrc

invalid-bracket.comment: Timing-shaped [...] tokens that failed the valid timestamp rule, e.g. [01:60]. Non-timing brackets are section labels, not errors.
invalid-bracket.name: invalid.illegal.bracket.lrc
